prompts.outside: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One finished editorial image for the Outside tile in Asocialmedia's About-page hero. Landscape 4:3 with a center-safe human subject for square and portrait cropping. A candid young East Asian man and his friend pausing on a small wooden footbridge above a clear forest stream, on a quiet weekend walk. Natural human faces and hands, one mustard windbreaker, one faded blue overshirt, forest green ferns, pale blue water, warm late-afternoon light, subtle analogue film grain. Intimate and outdoorsy, calm and real, generous environmental space, no posed stock-photo grins. Cooler greens and blues balanced by a little warm orange. Not a mascot scene. No Zeph, plush figures, writing, signage, logos, watermark or collage borders.
prompts.onRepeat: Use case: illustration-story. One finished editorial image for the On repeat music tile in Asocialmedia's About-page hero. Landscape 4:3, center-safe composition readable in small square and portrait crops. A young Black man with short twists and soft over-ear headphones by the window of a neighborhood tram, eyes gently closed while absorbed in his favourite song; one hand resting on a small music player with a blank screen. Hand-drawn contemporary editorial illustration with bold fluid ink contours, flat layered teal and coral shapes, gentle colored-pencil texture, cream highlights and a small warm yellow accent. Window light and simplified passing city shapes, warm and personal without an all-brown palette. The human subject is the focus; NOT a mascot or plush 3D render. No Zeph, no musical-note symbols, no readable text, no logos, no watermark, no grids or border.
